svg.title: Relay output wiring to the traffic light lamps
svg.desc: 120 volt AC hot feeds the common terminals of relays K1, K2 and K3. Each normally-open contact switches one lamp of the traffic light: K1 to green, K2 to yellow, K3 to red. Lamp commons return to AC neutral. K4 is unused.
svg.text: Relay output terminals — same flipped view as above
Mains voltage: kill the breaker before wiring, and enclose all relay terminals
Verify the NO / C / NC order against your board's silkscreen before connecting
